```plato
//==
// # ICamera interface
//
// The marker interface for a placed camera: a rigid pose plus the near and far
// clip distances that bound the rendered depth range. The implementing types
// are declared in `cameras.types.plato`; the derived bodies (including the
// AspectRatio obligation fills) live in `cameras.library.plato`.

// A placed camera: a rigid pose plus near and far clip distances bounding the
// rendered depth range. Invariant: 0 < Near < Far.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - View space (right-handed; forward is -Z, +Y up).
interface ICamera
    inherits IValue
{
    Pose(x: Self): Pose3D;
    Near(x: Self): Number;
    Far(x: Self): Number;
    // The image aspect ratio (width over height). PerspectiveCamera and
    // OrthographicCamera carry it as a field; the other camera types derive it
    // from their optics (see the AspectRatio bodies in cameras.library.plato).
    AspectRatio(x: Self): Number;
}
```
